en: Hey. You're the island challenger, aren't you? I'm Hapu. I'm from Poni Island, way out west.
I've been walking the islands to see how the people live. This ridge is hard going on foot, though.
Here. My Mudsdale knows the way over any rock. Put her in your Ride Pager and she'll come when you call.
{player} registered Mudsdale in the Ride Pager! Mudsdale can gallop over rough ground.
I'll be off. There's a shrine past the desert I want to see. Maybe I'll see you there.
You look like you could use a strong pair of legs under you. Hold on a moment.
